%macro finmes(fec);
intnx("month",&fec.,0)-1
%mend; %macro inimes(fec);
intnx("month",&fec.,-6)
%mend;

data bs_data;
INICIO=TODAY();
fim=%finmes(INICIO);
ini=%inimes(INICIO);
format fim ini YYMMDDn8.;
put fim ini;
run;

proc sql ;
   select distinct cat("'",put(fim,YYMMDDn8.),"'") as fim,cat("'",put(ini,YYMMDDn8.),"'") as ini

      into :fim, :ini
   from bs_data;

 %put &fim &ini;

%LET LOTE_ATUAL = 28;



DATA BS_SALES_ATIVO (WHERE=('Data da Aprovação'n NOT IS MISSING));
SET CASOS_ATIVOS_SALESFORCE;
RUN;

DATA BS_SALES_ATIVO;
SET BS_SALES_ATIVO;
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[.,!-,‘’.]//', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]//', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/-/ /', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/\d+//', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = upcase('Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[áàâãä]/a/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[éèêë]/e/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[íìîï]/i/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[óòôõö]/o/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[úùûü]/u/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÁÀÂÃÄ]/A/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÉÈÊË]/E/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÍÌÎÏ]/I/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÓÒÔÕÖ]/O/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÚÙÛÜ]/U/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/\s+/ /', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = strip('Nome sob análise'n );
;RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_SALES_1 AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		   DATEPART(t1.'Data da Aprovação'n) FORMAT DATE9. AS DT_APROVACAO,
		   input(Compress((tranwrd(tranwrd(tranwrd(T1.'CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n, ".",""),"-",""),"/",""))),14.)  FORMAT=BEST16. AS DOC_NUM

      FROM  BS_SALES_ATIVO t1
					   	;
QUIT;

proc sort data=BS_SALES_1; by DOC_NUM 'Nome sob análise'n DESCENDING DT_APROVACAO DESCENDING 'KYC: Data da última modificação'n DESCENDING 'Data de Expiração'n; run;
proc sort data=BS_SALES_1 nodupkey; by DOC_NUM; run;

DATA BS_SALES_N (WHERE=('Data da Aprovação'n NOT = .));
SET BASE_KYC;
RENAME DOCUMENTO = DOC_NUM;
RUN;

DATA BS_SALES_N;
SET BS_SALES_N;
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[.,!-,‘’.]//', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]//', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/-/ /', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/\d+//', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = upcase('Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[áàâãä]/a/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[éèêë]/e/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[íìîï]/i/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[óòôõö]/o/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[úùûü]/u/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÁÀÂÃÄ]/A/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÉÈÊË]/E/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÍÌÎÏ]/I/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÓÒÔÕÖ]/O/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/[ÚÙÛÜ]/U/', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = prxchange('s/\s+/ /', -1, 'Nome sob análise'n );
    'Nome sob análise'n  = strip('Nome sob análise'n );
;RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_SALES_N AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*

      FROM  BS_SALES_N T1
      LEFT JOIN BS_SALES_1 t2 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = t2.DOC_NUM)
	  WHERE t2.DOC_NUM IS MISSING
					   	;
QUIT;

proc sort data=BS_SALES_N; by DOC_NUM 'KYC: Data da última modificação'n; run;
proc sort data=BS_SALES_N nodupkey; by DOC_NUM; run;

DATA BS_SALES_FIM;
SET BS_SALES_1 BS_SALES_N;
RUN;








proc sql ;
   select distinct cat("'",put(fim,DATE9.),"'","D") as fim_n,cat("'",put(ini,DATE9.),"'","D") as ini_n

      into :fim_n, :ini_n
   from bs_data;

 %put &ini_n &fim_n;

DATA BS_SALES_RISCO (WHERE=('Risco PLD'n IN ('Risco Alto','Risco Extremo')
								AND (Status in ('ativo','em aprovação')))) ;
	SET BS_SALES_1;
		;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_SALES AS
   SELECT DISTINCT

		  Compress(tranwrd(tranwrd(tranwrd(t1.'CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n, ".",""),"-",""),"/","")) AS NuCpfCnpj,
          T1.DOC_NUM,
		  T1.'Nome sob análise'n,
          t1.'KYC: Data da última modificação'n FORMAT DATE9. AS DATA_ULTIMA

      FROM BS_SALES_RISCO t1

		   	     ;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_SME_RISCO AS
		SELECT DISTINCT
		  (CASE WHEN  'CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n IS MISSING THEN INPUT('CPF'n,BEST16.) ELSE
						INPUT('CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n ,BEST16.) END) FORMAT BEST16. AS DOC_NUM,
		  (CASE WHEN 'CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n IS MISSING THEN 'CPF'n ELSE 'CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n END)
				FORMAT $14. AS NuCpfCnpj,
		   DATEPART('KYP: Data da última modificação'n) FORMAT DATE9. AS DATA_ULTIMA

	FROM Base_SME_360
	WHERE STATUS IN ('ativo','em aprovação') AND 'Risco PLD'n IN ('Alto','Especial Atenção')
    AND (CASE WHEN  'CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n IS MISSING THEN INPUT('CPF'n,BEST16.) ELSE
						INPUT('CPF/CNPJ sob análise'n ,BEST16.) END) IS NOT MISSING;
QUIT;

proc sort data=BS_SME_RISCO; by DOC_NUM descending DATA_ULTIMA ; run;
proc sort data=BS_SME_RISCO nodupkey; by DOC_NUM; run;



PROC SQL;
CONNECT TO SYBASE (server=PTASYBCTR user=&USE_MORSYBCTR. password=&SENHA_MORSYBCTR.);
CREATE TABLE BS_KYP AS
	SELECT * FROM connection to SYBASE
	(
SELECT 	DISTINCT
	     B.NuRaizCnpjCorrespondenteBancro 	AS 'NuRaizCpfCnpj'
		, B.NuCnpjCorrespondenteBancario 	AS 'NuCpfCnpj'
		, A.NmFantasia						AS 'NmParceiroComercial'
		, '' 								AS 'FlAtivo'
		, CASE 	WHEN A.TpCorrespondente = 'V' 	THEN 'VEICULO'
			 	WHEN A.TpCorrespondente = 'C'	THEN 'CONSIGNADO'
			 	ELSE A.TpCorrespondente  END AS 'TpNegocio'
		, CASE A.CdRiscoPLD	WHEN 'B' THEN 'BAIXO'
							WHEN 'M' THEN 'MEDIO'
							WHEN 'B' THEN 'BAIXO'
							WHEN 'M' THEN 'MEDIO'
							WHEN 'A' THEN 'ESPECIAL ATENCAO'
							WHEN 'C' THEN 'COMITE'
							ELSE NULL END 	AS 'DsRiscoPLD'

		, A.DtInicioVigencia				AS 'DtInicioVigencia'
		, A.DtFimVigencia					AS 'DtFimVigencia'
		, C.DsStatusAnalise					AS 'DsStatusAnalise'
		, CASE 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise IN ('CADASTRO APROVADO', 'CADASTRO FINALIZADO') AND A.DtFimVigencia >= GETDATE() THEN 'VIGENTE'
			 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise IN ('CADASTRO APROVADO', 'CADASTRO FINALIZADO') AND A.DtFimVigencia < GETDATE() THEN 'VENCIDO'
			 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise IN ('CADASTRO APROVADO', 'CADASTRO FINALIZADO') AND A.DtFimVigencia IS NULL THEN 'VIGENTE SEM APROV. PLD'
			 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'ENVIADO PARA CADASTRO' 			THEN 'CADASTRO'
			 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'AGUARDANDO ENVIO ANALISE' 		THEN 'EDITANDO'
			 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'EM DIGITACAO' 		   			THEN 'EDITANDO'
			 	WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'FORMALIZACAO DE CADASTRO'			THEN 'CADASTRO'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'FICHA CANCELADA' 		  			THEN 'CANCELADO'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'DEVOLVIDO PARA COMERCIAL (PLD)' 	THEN 'COMERCIAL'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'DEVOLVIDO PARA COMERCIAL (CAD 2)' THEN 'COMERCIAL'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'DEVOLVIDO PARA COMERCIAL (CAD 1)' THEN 'COMERCIAL'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'ENVIADO ANALISE PLD' 	  			THEN 'PLD'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'EM ANALISE PLD' 		 			THEN 'PLD'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'DEVOLVIDO PARA PLD' 	 			THEN 'PLD'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'RECUSADO PLD' 		 			THEN 'REJEITADO'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'RECUSADO CREDITO' 	 			THEN 'REJEITADO'
		 		WHEN C.DsStatusAnalise = 'ENVIADO ANALISE CREDITO'		 	THEN 'CREDITO'
		 		ELSE C.DsStatusAnalise END 	AS 'DsStatusKYP'

FROM	dbcorrespondentebancario..TbFichaCorrespondenteBancario				A
		LEFT JOIN dbcorrespondentebancario..TbRegistroCorrespondenteBancro 	B ON A.CdRegistroCorrespondenteBancar 	= B.CdRegistroCorrespondenteBancro
		LEFT JOIN dbcorrespondentebancario..TbStatusAnalise					C ON A.CdStatusAnalise 					= C.CdStatusAnalise
		LEFT JOIN DBCOR..TbAtividFinancParcComercial						D ON A.CdParceiroComercial				= D.CdParceiroComercial
		LEFT JOIN DBCOR..TbAtividadeFinanciamento							E ON D.CdAtividadeFinanciamento			= E.CdAtividadeFinanciamento



		);
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_KYP_VIGENTE AS
			SELECT DISTINCT A.*
				 FROM BS_KYP AS A INNER JOIN (SELECT NuCpfCnpj, MAX(DtInicioVigencia) AS Max_DtInicioVigencia FROM BS_KYP
										 GROUP BY NuCpfCnpj) AS C
			ON(A.NuCpfCnpj = C.NuCpfCnpj AND A.DtInicioVigencia = C.Max_DtInicioVigencia)
			

			ORDER BY 2
;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CONNECT TO SYBASE AS DBCON (SERVER=MORSYBCTR USER=&USE_MORSYBCTR. PASSWORD=&SENHA_MORSYBCTR.);
CREATE TABLE BS_ATIVO_GLOBAL AS
	SELECT *
	FROM CONNECTION TO DBCON
	(SELECT DISTINCT
         A.CdPessoa
	    ,A.NuCpfCnpj
		,A.NmPessoa
		,G.CdTipoRelacionamento
		,Z.CdPessoaFuncionario
		,C.CdDivisaoComercial
	    ,D.NmDivisaoComercial
		,D.CdDivisaoComercialTopo

		FROM DBGLOBAL..TbPessoa A
        LEFT JOIN DBGLOBAL..TbCliente Z ON A.CdPessoa = Z.CdPessoa
	 	LEFT JOIN DBGLOBAL..TbPessoaTipoRelacionamento G ON A.CdPessoa = G.CdPessoa
		LEFT JOIN DBGLOBAL..TbPessoaJuridica E ON A.CdPessoa = E.CdPessoa
        LEFT JOIN DBGLOBAL..TbFuncionarioAreaComercial C ON Z.CdPessoaFuncionario = C.CdPessoaFuncionario
		LEFT JOIN DBGLOBAL..TbDivisaoComercial D ON D.CdDivisaoComercial = C.CdDivisaoComercial
        WHERE G.CdTipoRelacionamento IN (02, 13, 62)
);
	DISCONNECT FROM DBCON;
	quit;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          T1.CNPJ_FUNDO FORMAT BEST14. AS docConsultado,
          (CASE WHEN t2.Exclusivo = 'S' THEN 'S'
                WHEN t2.Exclusivo = 'N' THEN 'N'
                WHEN t3.FUNDO_EXCLUSIVO = 'S' THEN 'S'
                WHEN t3.FUNDO_EXCLUSIVO = 'N' THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END) AS FUNDO_EXCLUSIVO_CALC,
          (CASE WHEN t1.Situacao IN ('Cancelado') THEN 'N_ATIVO' ELSE 'ATIVO' end) AS SIT_CALC,
		  T1.CNPJ_Administrador FORMAT BEST14. AS docADMIN,
          T1.Administrador as ADMIN,
		  T1.CPF_CNPJ_Gestor FORMAT BEST14. AS docGESTOR,
          T1.GESTOR

      FROM registro_fundo_ND t1
	  LEFT JOIN registro_classe T2 ON (INPUT(T1.ID_Registro_Fundo,BEST8.) = T2.ID_Registro_Fundo)
	  LEFT JOIN cad_fi_hist_exclusivo_nd T3 ON (INPUT(compress(T3.CNPJ_FUNDO,, 'kn'),BEST14.) = T1.CNPJ_FUNDO)
	  WHERE T2.Situacao NOT IN ('Cancelado') and T1.CNPJ_FUNDO > 0

;QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE cad_fi_hist_exclusivo_nd AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          INPUT(compress(CNPJ_FUNDO,, 'kn'),BEST14.)  FORMAT BEST14. AS docConsultado,
          (CASE WHEN DT_FIM_ST_EXCLUSIVO IS MISSING THEN 'ATIVO' ELSE 'N_ATIVO' END) AS SIT_CALC

      FROM cad_fi_hist_exclusivo_nd t1
	  LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T2 ON (INPUT(compress(T1.CNPJ_FUNDO,, 'kn'),BEST14.) = T2.docConsultado)
	  WHERE T2.docConsultado IS MISSING AND T2.FUNDO_EXCLUSIVO_CALC = 'S/INFO'

;QUIT;

DATA BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_FIM (WHERE=(docConsultado > 0));
SET cad_fi_hist_exclusivo_nd BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO;

RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_FIM NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_;RUN;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_360_COUNT_F AS
	SELECT *,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_FIM
GROUP BY docConsultado
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;


data PLD.BS_QSA_FIM;

run;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_F AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.TP_QUADRO,
          t1.NOME_QUADRO,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.NuConsultado,
          t1.docConsultado,
          t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          (CASE WHEN t4.docConsultado IS NOT MISSING THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS Fl_Principal_Fundos,
		  (CASE WHEN t5.docConsultado IS NOT MISSING THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Fl_QSA_Fundo

      FROM PLD.BS_QSA_FIM t1
	  LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_FIM t4 ON (t1.docConsultado = t4.docConsultado)
	  LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_FIM t5 ON (t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = t5.docConsultado)

      WHERE T1.NOME_QUADRO NOT IN ('NÃO SE APLICA','ACOES EM TESOURARIA','FASE PRÉ-OPERACIONAL - 05/04/2024',
            'PREOPERACIONAL')

;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_F AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		 (CASE WHEN T2.NUCONSULTADO IS NOT MISSING AND T1.TP_QUADRO IN ('SOCIO PF','RESPONSAVEL') THEN 'SOCIO PF'
		       WHEN T3.NUCONSULTADO IS NOT MISSING AND T1.TP_QUADRO IN ('SOCIO PF','DIRETORIA') THEN 'SOCIO PF'
		       ELSE T1.TP_QUADRO END) FORMAT $150. AS TP_QUADRO1

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_F t1
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT t1.NUCONSULTADO,t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO
                 FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_F t1 WHERE t1.TP_QUADRO = 'RESPONSAVEL' )T2
				ON (T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCONSULTADO AND T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T2.DOC_NUM_QUADRO)
	 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT t1.NUCONSULTADO,t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO
                 FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_F t1 WHERE t1.TP_QUADRO = 'DIRETORIA' )T3
				ON (T1.NUCONSULTADO = T3.NUCONSULTADO AND T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T3.DOC_NUM_QUADRO)

;QUIT;

DATA BS_QSA_FINAL_F;
SET BS_QSA_FINAL_F;
DROP TP_QUADRO;
RENAME TP_QUADRO1 = TP_QUADRO;
RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_QSA_FINAL_F NODUPKEY; bY _ALL_;RUN;



PROC SORT DATA=BS_QSA_FINAL_F NODUPKEY; bY NuConsultado docConsultado DOC_NUM_QUADRO FL_QSA Fl_Principal_Fundos Fl_QSA_Fundo TP_QUADRO
;RUN;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_COUNT AS
	SELECT
    *,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_F
GROUP BY NuConsultado,DOC_NUM_QUADRO,FL_QSA
HAVING Count(*) > 1 AND DOC_NUM_QUADRO not in (0,99999999999999)
;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DOC_INI AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
      T2.NUCPFCNPJ,
	  t2.nome,
	  T2.ESTEIRA,
	  t2.nome,
	  t2.ELEGIVEL,
     (CASE WHEN T1.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN T1.FL_QSA
		    ELSE 'S/INFO' END) FORMAT $100. AS FL_QSA,
	  (CASE WHEN T1.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN 'DOCUMENTO'
		    ELSE 'S/INFO' END)FORMAT $100. AS FL_TIPO,
	  (CASE WHEN T1.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN T1.NUCONSULTADO
		    ELSE '' END) AS NUCONSULTADO

      FROM PLD.BS_360_FINAL T2
      LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_F T1 ON (T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCPFCNPJ AND INPUT(T1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.) > 0)
	  WHERE T2.TpPessoa = 'J' and t2.ELEGIVEL NOT IN ('BLOQUEADO','CONSULTA SIMPLIFICADA','ENCERRADO_MONITORAMENTO',
            'BLOQUEADO KYC','BLOQUEADO KYP' )

;QUIT;

DATA BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DOC (WHERE=(FL_QSA NOT = 'S/INFO'));
SET BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DOC_INI;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_RAIZ_INI AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
      T2.NUCPFCNPJ,
	  t2.nome,
	  T2.ESTEIRA,
	  t2.nome,
	  t2.ELEGIVEL,
      (CASE WHEN T3.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN T3.FL_QSA
			ELSE 'S/INFO' END) FORMAT $100. AS FL_QSA,
	  (CASE WHEN T3.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN 'RAIZ'
			ELSE 'S/INFO' END)FORMAT $100. AS FL_TIPO,
	  (CASE WHEN T3.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN T3.NUCONSULTADO
			ELSE '' END) AS NUCONSULTADO

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DOC_INI T2
	  LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_F T3 ON (INPUT(SUBSTR(T3.NUCONSULTADO,1,8),BEST14.)= INPUT(SUBSTR(T2.NUCPFCNPJ,1,8),BEST14.)
      AND INPUT(SUBSTR(T3.NUCONSULTADO,1,8),BEST14.) > 0)
      WHERE T2.FL_QSA = 'S/INFO'
;QUIT;

DATA BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_RAIZ (WHERE=(FL_QSA NOT = 'S/INFO'));
SET BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_RAIZ_INI;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_NOMES_INI AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
      T2.NUCPFCNPJ,
	  t2.nome,
	  T2.ESTEIRA,
	  t2.nome,
	  t2.ELEGIVEL,
	  (CASE WHEN T1.FL_QSA IS MISSING THEN 'S/INFO' ELSE T1.FL_QSA END) FORMAT $100. AS FL_QSA,
	  (CASE WHEN T1.FL_QSA IS MISSING THEN 'S/INFO' ELSE 'DOCUMENTO' END) FORMAT $100. AS FL_TIPO,
	  (CASE WHEN T1.FL_QSA IS MISSING THEN T2.NUCPFCNPJ ELSE T1.NUCONSULTADO END) AS NUCONSULTADO

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_RAIZ_INI T2
	  LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_RAIZ T3 ON (T2.NuCpfCnpj = T3.NuCpfCnpj)
      LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_F T1 ON (T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCPFCNPJ)
      WHERE t3.NuCpfCnpj IS MISSING;
QUIT;

DATA BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DEMAIS (WHERE=(FL_QSA NOT = 'S/INFO'));
SET BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_NOMES_INI;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_NOMES AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
      T2.NUCPFCNPJ,
	  t2.nome,
	  T2.ESTEIRA,
	  t2.nome,
	  t2.ELEGIVEL,
	  (CASE WHEN T3.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN T3.FL_QSA
			ELSE 'S/INFO' END) FORMAT $100. AS FL_QSA,
	  (CASE WHEN T3.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN 'NOMES'
			ELSE 'S/INFO' END)FORMAT $100. AS FL_TIPO,
	  (CASE WHEN T3.FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO','GRUPO_BV') THEN T3.NUCONSULTADO
			ELSE T2.NUCONSULTADO END) AS NUCONSULTADO

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_NOMES_INI T2
      LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_F T3 ON (T2.NOME = T3.NOME)
	  LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DEMAIS T1 ON (T2.NuCpfCnpj = T1.NuCpfCnpj)
	  WHERE t1.NuCpfCnpj IS MISSING;

QUIT;

DATA BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA;
SET BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DEMAIS BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_RAIZ BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_DOC BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA_NOMES;
RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA;table FL_QSA /nopercent nocum;RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
      T1.*,
	  (CASE WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO = '15174730000186' then 1510600
            WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO = '54888270000100' then 6470102
			WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO = '35192878000150' then 7020400
			WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO in ('02633346000152','21575314000192','21575356000123','21575389000173',
			                       '21608903000120') then 7911200
           WHEN t2.NumCpfCnpj is not missing then
                 INPUT(Compress((tranwrd(tranwrd(tranwrd(T2.cd_cnae, ".",""),"-",""),"/",""))),BEST8.) ELSE T1.CNAE END) AS CNAE1

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA T1

            WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO = '54888270000100' then 6470102
			WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO = '35192878000150' then 7020400
			WHEN t1.NUCONSULTADO in ('02633346000152','21575314000192','21575356000123','21575389000173',
			                       '21608903000120') then 7911200

            when t2.NumCpfCnpj is not missing
            then INPUT(Compress((tranwrd(tranwrd(tranwrd(T2.cd_cnae, ".",""),"-",""),"/",""))),BEST8.) ELSE T1.CNAE END) AS CNAE1

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
      T1.*,
	  INPUT(T1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.) FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM,
	  (CASE WHEN t2.docConsultado IS NOT MISSING THEN 'FUNDOS'
            ELSE T1.ESTEIRA END) FORMAT $100. AS ESTEIRA_NOVA,
      (CASE WHEN t4.CdCNPJ IS NOT MISSING THEN 'FUNDO_VAM'
            WHEN t3.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING THEN 'GRUPO_VOTORANTIM'
            WHEN t5.DOC_NUM IS NOT MISSING THEN 'GRUPO_VOTORANTIM'
			WHEN INPUT(t1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.) IN (13052891000171,23740642000122) THEN 'GRUPO_VOTORANTIM'
		
            ELSE T1.ELEGIVEL END) FORMAT $50. AS ELEGIVEL_NOVO

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA T1
      LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_FIM t2 ON (INPUT(t1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.) = t2.docConsultado)
	  LEFT JOIN BS_ADM_VAM t4 ON (t1.NUCONSULTADO = t4.CdCNPJ)
	  LEFT JOIN BS_RELACIONADA t3 ON (INPUT(t1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.) = t3.NuCpfCnpj)
	  LEFT JOIN BS_GRUPO_BV_F t5 ON (INPUT(t1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.)= t5.DOC_NUM)
	  LEFT JOIN PLD.BS_360_FINAL T7 ON (INPUT(t1.NUCONSULTADO,BEST14.)= t7.DOC_NUM)
     

;
QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA= BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA nodupkey;BY NuCpfCnpj ESTEIRA ELEGIVEL FL_QSA FL_TIPO NUCONSULTADO CNAE
DOC_NUM ESTEIRA_NOVA ELEGIVEL_NOVO;RUN;

%macro finmes(fec);
   intnx("month",&fec.,-1,"end")
%mend;

%macro inimes(fec);
   intnx("month",&fec.,-36,"beginning")
%mend;

data bs_data;
   INICIO = TODAY();
   REF_COAF_FIM = %finmes(INICIO);
   REF_COAF_INI = %inimes(INICIO);
   format REF_COAF_FIM REF_COAF_INI DATE9.;
   put REF_COAF_FIM= REF_COAF_INI=;
run;

proc sql ;
   select distinct cat("'",put(REF_COAF_FIM,DATE9.),"'","d") as REF_COAF_FIM,cat("'",put(REF_COAF_INI,DATE9.),"'","d") as REF_COAF_INI

      into :REF_COAF_FIM, :REF_COAF_INI
   from bs_data;

 %put &REF_COAF_FIM &REF_COAF_INI;

  		SELECT DISTINCT
				MESREF

	FROM BASE_ALERTAS
	ORDER BY (MESREF) desc;

PROC EXPORT data=BASE_ALERTAS_ANOMES
	dbms= XLSX REPLACE

	sheet="Plan1";

RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ALERTAS_FIM AS
   SELECT t1.*
      FROM BASE_ALERTAS t1 INNER JOIN BASE_ALERTAS_ANOMES T2 ON(T1.MESREF = T2.MESREF)
      ;
QUIT;

DATA BASE_ALERTA_ND (KEEP= MESREF CPFCNPJ PRODUTO_CANAL);
SET BASE_ALERTAS_FIM;
IF PRODUTO_CANAL IN ('CARTAO NEON PF', 'CONTA NEON','DOCK','DTVM','IPIRANGA','PIX','QESH',
                     'RECEBÍVEIS','S3','DIGITAL') THEN DELETE;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ALERTA_SUM AS
   SELECT DISTINCT t1.CPFCNPJ,
          t1.PRODUTO_CANAL AS PRODUTO,
          (COUNT(t1.CPFCNPJ)) AS QTDE_ALERTAS,
		  (CASE WHEN t1.PRODUTO_CANAL IN ('BANCO DIGITAL','CAMBIO','CONTA CORRENTE','CREDITO ATACADO',
                                           'CRIPTO APOSTAS','MELIUZ','ELEICOES 2024') THEN 3
		        WHEN t1.PRODUTO_CANAL IN ('LEILAO','CARTAO BV','DEVICES') THEN 2
                WHEN t1.PRODUTO_CANAL IN ('CDC','RODAS','COBAN','REGRAS CADASTRA') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_PRODUTO

      FROM BASE_ALERTA_ND t1
      GROUP BY t1.CPFCNPJ,
               t1.PRODUTO_CANAL;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_ALERTA_SUM ; TABLES SCORE_PRODUTO /nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_ALERTA_SUM ; TABLES PRODUTO*SCORE_PRODUTO /nopercent nocum; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ALERTA_SUM AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
          	t1.CPFCNPJ,
          	(SUM(t1.QTDE_ALERTAS)) AS QTDE_ALERTAS,
          	t1.SCORE_PRODUTO
      	FROM BASE_ALERTA_SUM t1
      		GROUP BY t1.CPFCNPJ,
               		 t1.SCORE_PRODUTO;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_360_ALERTA AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN A.QTDE_ALERTAS IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE A.QTDE_ALERTAS END) AS QTDE_ALERTAS,

			(CASE WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS >=5 AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 3) THEN 27

				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS =4 AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 3) THEN 9
				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS >=5 AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 2) THEN 9

				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS =3  AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 3) THEN 3
				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS =2  AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 3) THEN 3
				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS =4  AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 2) THEN 3
				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS >=5 AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 1) THEN 3

				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS <=4  AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 1) THEN 1
				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS <=3 AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 2) THEN 1
				  WHEN (A.QTDE_ALERTAS = 1 AND A.SCORE_PRODUTO = 3) THEN 1

				  		ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_ALERTA6M

FROM BASE_ALERTA_SUM A;
QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_360_ALERTA;
BY CPFCNPJ DESCENDING SCORE_ALERTA6M DESCENDING SCORE_PRODUTO;
RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_360_ALERTA NODUPKEY;
BY CPFCNPJ;
RUN;

RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=LISTA_BLOQUEADOS_INI NODUPKEY;BY _ALL_;RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE LISTA_BLOQUEADOS_1  AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
		  	t1.DOC_NUM,
		   	T1.TPPESSOA,
			t1.TPLISTA,
		    SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'CEIS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS CEIS,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'TRAB_ESCRAVO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS TRAB_ESCRAVO,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('Proprietário preso por envol','Mídia Negativa') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS MIDIA,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'CNEP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS CNEP,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'LENIENCIA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS LENIENCIA,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'CEPIM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS CEPIM,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('RECUSADO','Recusados','Recusados Matriz','RECUSADO BD',
                                        'RECUSADO MATRIZ','RECUSADO MELIUZ','RECUSADO ONEPLD','RECUSADO SALES') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS RECUSADOS,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('Monitoramento de PLD','CONTA PONTE','PLD2','MONITORAMENTO TRANSACIONAL',
                                        'MONITORAMENTO_MELIUZ','Monitoramento de PLD / BAAS','Device') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS MONITORAMENTO_PLD,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('DENUNCIA','Denúncia','Denuncia') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS DENUNCIA,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('Reportados Coaf','Sancionados') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS OUTROS,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'FRAUDES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS LISTA_FRAUDES,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA = 'Favorecido Bloqueado' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS Fav_Bloqueado,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IS MISSING THEN 1
                      WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('BLOQUEADO ONEPLD','BLOQUEADOS ONEPLD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS BLOQ_ONEPLD,
			SUM((CASE WHEN T1.LISTA IN ('Renovação Continua','Renovação Contínua') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS RENOVACAO

   FROM LISTA_BLOQUEADOS_INI t1
   WHERE T1.DOC_NUM NOT=. AND T1.DOC_NUM >0 AND t1.TPLISTA IN ('IMPEDITIVO','RESTRITIVO')
   GROUP BY T1.DOC_NUM
   ;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_360_FIM_PF AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
	      t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          t1.TpPessoa,
          T1.ESTEIRA,
		  T1.NOME AS NOME,
          0 AS KYE,
		  T1.VISAO_360,
		  t1.NUM_KYC,
		  (CASE WHEN T1.DOC_NUM IN (1041498764,6266331926,7925106581,11693250764,34487872804,38614367368
		             39275973172,54903777391) THEN 'SIM' ELSE t1.ELEGIVEL END) FORMAT $50. AS ELEGIVEL,
		  (CASE WHEN T2.DOC_RELA IS MISSING THEN T1.DOC_NUM ELSE T2.DOC_RELA END) AS DOC_RELA,
		  (CASE WHEN T2.TpPessoa_N IS MISSING THEN T1.TpPessoa ELSE T2.TpPessoa_N END) AS TpPessoa_N,
		  (CASE WHEN T2.TIPO IS MISSING THEN 'CPF_PRINCIPAL' ELSE T2.TIPO END) FORMAT $50. AS TIPO

      FROM BS_360_FINAL_PF t1
		LEFT JOIN BS_PROCURADORES_PF T2 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T2.DOC_NUM)

UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
          t2.NuCpfCnpj,
          t2.DOC_NUM,
          t2.TpPessoa,
          t2.ESTEIRA,
		  T2.NOME AS NOME,
          0 AS KYE,
		  t2.VISAO_360,
		  t2.NUM_KYC,
		  (CASE WHEN T2.DOC_NUM IN (1041498764,6266331926,7925106581,11693250764,34487872804,38614367368
		             39275973172,54903777391) THEN 'SIM' ELSE t2.ELEGIVEL END) FORMAT $50. AS ELEGIVEL,
		  t2.DOC_NUM AS DOC_RELA,
		  t2.TpPessoa AS TpPessoa_N,
		  'CPF_PRINCIPAL' AS TIPO

      FROM BS_360_FINAL_PF t2
		;
QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_360_FIM_PF NODUPKEY;BY _ALL_; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FIM_PF ; TABLES TpPessoa_N; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FIM_PF ; TABLES ESTEIRA; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FIM_PF ; TABLES TIPO; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FIM_PF ; TABLES ELEGIVEL; RUN ;

DATA BS_360_FIM_PF;
SET BS_360_FIM_PF;
IF DOC_NUM = DOC_RELA and TIPO = 'PROCURADOR' THEN DELETE;RUN;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_360_COAF AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN B.QTDE IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.QTDE END) AS QTDE_COAF,
            (CASE WHEN B.QTDE >=3 THEN 27
                  WHEN B.QTDE =2 THEN 9
                  WHEN B.QTDE =1 THEN 3
                  WHEN B.QTDE IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_COAF

FROM BS_360_FIM_PF_ELE A LEFT JOIN BS_COAF_FINAL_36 B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM = B.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_COAF ; TABLES SCORE_COAF; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_COAF ; TABLES SCORE_COAF*QTDE_COAF; RUN ;







PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_FULL_CAMBIO AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
		  *,
          input(Compress(NR_CGC_CPF),14.) FORMAT=BEST16. AS DOC_NUM,
		  input(Compress(IdPais_Contraparte),8.) FORMAT=BEST12. AS IdPais

      FROM BASE_CAMBIO_FINAL t1
        WHERE t1.TPPESSOA = 'F';
               ;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_FULL_CAMBIO AS
   SELECT t1.*,
          (CASE WHEN T1.MODALIDADE_PAGAMENTO = 'PAGTO ANTECIPADO FIN' THEN 1
                WHEN T1.MODALIDADE_PAGAMENTO = 'Pagamento Antecipado' THEN 1
					 ELSE 0 END) AS PGTO_ANTECIPADO,
          (CASE WHEN t2.PAIS IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS PAISES_PROIBIDO
      FROM BASE_FULL_CAMBIO t1
           LEFT JOIN PLD.PAISES_RESTRITOS t2 ON (t1.IdPais = t2.CD_BACEN);
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PAISES AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NR_CGC_CPF,
          (t1.DsPais_CONTRAPARTE) AS DsPais_CONTRAPARTE,
		  t1.IdPais

      FROM WORK.BASE_FULL_CAMBIO t1
      WHERE t1.PAISES_PROIBIDO = 1;
QUIT;

DATA BS_CONCAT;
SET BS_PAISES;
FORMAT DSPAIS_SANCIONADO $char100.;
RETAIN DSPAIS_SANCIONADO;
	IF FIRST.NR_CGC_CPF then DSPAIS_SANCIONADO = '';
BY NR_CGC_CPF;
DSPAIS_SANCIONADO = CATX(' ',DsPais_CONTRAPARTE,DSPAIS_SANCIONADO);
IF LAST.NR_CGC_CPF;

DROP DsPais_CONTRAPARTE;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_FIM AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NR_CGC_CPF,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          (SUM(t1.VL_MN)) FORMAT=BEST12. AS VL_MN,
          (COUNT(t1.NR_CGC_CPF)) AS QTDE,
           SUM(t1.PAISES_PROIBIDO) AS QTPAISES_SANCIONADOS,
          (SUM(t1.PGTO_ANTECIPADO)/(COUNT(t1.NR_CGC_CPF))) FORMAT percent10.0 AS PGTO_ANTECIPADO,
		  (SUM(t1.PAISES_PROIBIDO)/(COUNT(t1.NR_CGC_CPF))) FORMAT percent10.0 AS PAISES_SANCIONADOS,
          t2.DSPAIS_SANCIONADO

      FROM BASE_FULL_CAMBIO t1
	  	LEFT JOIN BS_CONCAT t2 ON (T1.NR_CGC_CPF = T2.NR_CGC_CPF)
      		GROUP BY t1.NR_CGC_CPF,
               		 t1.DOC_NUM;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.VL_MN END)
								FORMAT BEST12. AS VL_MN,
			(CASE WHEN B.PGTO_ANTECIPADO IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.PGTO_ANTECIPADO END)
								FORMAT percent10.0 AS PGTO_ANTECIPADO,
			(CASE WHEN B.PAISES_SANCIONADOS IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.PAISES_SANCIONADOS END)
								FORMAT percent10.0 AS PAISES_SANCIONADOS,
		    (CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0
                 WHEN B.VL_MN >=3000000 THEN 9
                  WHEN B.VL_MN <=3000000 THEN 3
                   ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO_INI,
		   B.DSPAIS_SANCIONADO

FROM BS_360_COAF A LEFT JOIN BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_FIM B
	ON (A.DOC_RELA = B.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL ; TABLES SCORE_CAMBIO_INI; RUN;





PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 OR A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO > 0.20) AND
						A.SCORE_CAMBIO_INI = 9 THEN 27
				  WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 OR A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO > 0.20) AND
						A.SCORE_CAMBIO_INI = 3 THEN 9
                  		ELSE A.SCORE_CAMBIO_INI END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM,
			(CASE WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 AND A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO > 0.20) THEN 'UPGRADE POR AMBOS'
				  WHEN A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 THEN 'UPGRADE POR PAISES SANCIONADOS'
				  WHEN  A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO >0.20 THEN 'UPGRADE POR PTO ANTECIPADO'
				  WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS < 0 OR A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO <= 0.20) THEN 'SEM UPGRADE'
                  		ELSE 'SEM CAMBIO' END) AS UPGRADE_CAMBIO

FROM BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL A ;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL ; TABLES SCORE_CAMBIO_INI*SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM; RUN ;

DATA BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL;
SET BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL;
RENAME SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM = SCORE_CAMBIO;
DROP SCORE_CAMBIO_INI;
RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_CAMBIO_TOTAL ; TABLES SCORE_CAMBIO; RUN ;




;
;
;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_360_LISTAS AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
		  	t1.*,
		  	COALESCE(T2.CEIS,0) AS LISTA_CEIS,

			COALESCE(T2.LENIENCIA,0) AS LISTA_LENIENCIA,
			COALESCE(T2.CEPIM,0) AS LISTA_CEPIM,

			COALESCE(T2.MONITORAMENTO_PLD,0) AS LISTA_MONITORA_PLD,
			COALESCE(T2.DENUNCIA,0) AS LISTA_DENUNCIA,
			COALESCE(T2.OUTROS,0) AS LISTA_OUTROS,
			COALESCE(T2.LISTA_FRAUDES,0) AS LISTA_FRAUDES,
			COALESCE(T2.Fav_Bloqueado,0) AS LISTA_FAV_BLOQUEADO,
			COALESCE(T2.BLOQ_ONEPLD,0) AS LISTA_BLOQ_ONEPLD,
			COALESCE(T2.RENOVACAO,0) AS LISTA_RENOVACAO

   FROM BS_360_ALERTA_FULL t1 LEFT JOIN LISTA_BLOQUEADOS T2
	ON (T1.DOC_RELA = T2.DOC_NUM);
           ;

QUIT;

PROC SQL;

			*,
			(CASE WHEN (LISTA_CEIS + LISTA_TRAB_ESCRAVO +

                        LISTA_RECUSA + LISTA_MONITORA_PLD + LISTA_DENUNCIA + LISTA_OUTROS +
                        LISTA_FRAUDES + LISTA_FAV_BLOQUEADO +
                        LISTA_BLOQ_ONEPLD + LISTA_RENOVACAO) = 0
					THEN 0 ELSE 27 END) AS SCORE_LISTA

FROM BS_360_LISTAS
 ;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_360_PEP AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			B.NmCargo AS CARGO_PEP,
			B.NmOrgao AS ORGAO_PEP,
			(CASE WHEN B.SCORE_FIM = 'EXTREMO' THEN 27
                  WHEN B.SCORE_FIM = 'ALTO' THEN 9
				  WHEN B.SCORE_FIM = 'MÉDIO' THEN 3
				  WHEN B.SCORE_FIM = 'BAIXO' THEN 1
				  WHEN B.GRAURELACIONAMENTO IS NOT MISSING THEN 100
				  	ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_PEP,
			B.SCORE_PEP,
		    B.UF AS UF_PEP,
			B.GRAURELACIONAMENTO AS RELACAO_PEP

FROM BS_360_LISTAS A LEFT JOIN BS_CLI_PEP B
	ON (A.DOC_RELA = B.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_PEP ; TABLES SCORE_PEP; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_360_PEP AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
		  	t1.*,
		  (CASE WHEN T3.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING THEN 9 ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_PEPINTERNACIONAL,
		  (CASE WHEN T3.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING AND t1.CARGO_PEP IS NOT MISSING THEN
                CATX(' ',t1.CARGO_PEP,' e Match em PEP Internacional')
                WHEN T3.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING THEn 'Match em PEP Internacional'
                ELSE t1.CARGO_PEP END) format $200. as CARGO_PEP1

   FROM BS_360_PEP t1
   LEFT JOIN '_Renovação_PF__ConsultaSançõesPE'n T3 ON (T1.DOC_RELA = T3.NuCpfCnpj)
    ;

QUIT;

DATA BS_360_PEP;
SET BS_360_PEP;
DROP CARGO_PEP;
RENAME CARGO_PEP1 = CARGO_PEP;
RUN;




;
;
;


PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_ESPECIE AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			COALESCE(B.TOTAL,0) AS Vr_Especie,
			(CASE WHEN B.TOTAL IS MISSING THEN  'Sem Espécie'
                  WHEN B.TOTAL <10000 THEN  'Até 10 mil'
  				  WHEN B.TOTAL >=10000 AND B.TOTAL <20000 THEN 'de 10 a 20 mil'
  	    		  WHEN B.TOTAL >=20000 AND B.TOTAL <=50000 THEN 'de 20 a 50 mil'
		          	ELSE 'Acima de 50 mil' END) AS FAIXA_ESPECIE,
			(CASE WHEN B.TOTAL > 50000 THEN 27
			      WHEN B.TOTAL >=20000 AND B.TOTAL <=50000 THEN 9
                  WHEN B.TOTAL >=10000 AND B.TOTAL < 20000 THEN 3
				  	ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_ESPECIE

FROM BS_360_PEP A LEFT JOIN BS_SAQUE_FIM B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM = INPUT(B.NuCpfCnpj,BEST14.));
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_ESPECIE ; TABLES SCORE_ESPECIE; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_ESPECIE ; TABLES Vr_Especie; RUN ;



PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_FIM AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          (CASE WHEN T1.SCORE_COAF IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_COAF) END) AS SCORE_COAF,
		  (CASE WHEN T1.SCORE_CAMBIO IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_CAMBIO) END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO,
          (CASE WHEN T1.SCORE_ALERTA6M IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M) END) AS SCORE_ALERTA6M,
          (CASE WHEN T1.SCORE_LISTA IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_LISTA) END) AS SCORE_LISTA,
		  (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_PEP,t1.SCORE_PEPINTERNACIONAL) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_PEP,t1.SCORE_PEPINTERNACIONAL) END) AS SCORE_PEP,
          (CASE WHEN T1.SCORE_ESPECIE IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_ESPECIE) END) AS SCORE_ESPECIE

     FROM BS_ESPECIE t1
      GROUP BY t1.DOC_NUM

			;

QUIT;

DATA BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE;
SET BS_PF_FIM;
SCORE_FINAL = (SCORE_LISTA + SCORE_COAF + SCORE_CAMBIO +
				SCORE_ALERTA6M + SCORE_ESPECIE + SCORE_PEP);

RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE;BY DOC_NUM DESCENDING SCORE_FINAL;RUN;
PROC SORT DATA=BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE NODUPKEY;BY DOC_NUM; RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE ; TABLES SCORE_FINAL; RUN ;

DATA BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE;
SET BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE;
riscoMatriz = 3;
IF SCORE_FINAL <3 THEN riscoMatriz = 1;
IF SCORE_FINAL >=3 AND SCORE_FINAL <18 THEN riscoMatriz = 2;

RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE ; TABLES riscoMatriz; RUN ;

DATA BS_PF_COUNT (KEEP=DOC_NUM riscoMatriz);
SET BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE;
RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PF_COUNT NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_; RUN;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_PF_COUNT AS
	SELECT DISTINCT
    DOC_NUM,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_PF_COUNT
GROUP BY DOC_NUM
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_FIM AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
          t2.SCORE_COAF AS SCORE_COAF_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_CAMBIO AS SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_ALERTA6M AS SCORE_ALERTA6M_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_LISTA AS SCORE_LISTA_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_PEP AS SCORE_PEP_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_ESPECIE AS SCORE_ESPECIE_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_FINAL,
          t2.riscoMatriz

     FROM BS_ESPECIE t1 LEFT JOIN BS_PF_FINAL_SCORE T2 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T2.DOC_NUM)

		;

QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PF_FIM NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_; RUN;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_360_COUNT AS
	SELECT DOC_NUM,DOC_RELA,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_PF_FIM
GROUP BY DOC_NUM,DOC_RELA
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;

DATA BS_PF_FIM;
SET BS_360_FIM_PF_INE BS_PF_FIM;
RUN;










proc sql OUTOBS=12;
	CREATE TABLE BASE_PF_NOMES  AS
  	select
		(memname) as TabelaMatriz
		into :Alertas
	from dictionary.tables
	where libname = 'PLD'
	and memname like 'BS_PF_FINAL_2%'
		order by (memname) desc;
quit;

proc sql noprint;
	select
		 TabelaMatriz into :TabelaMatriz
	from BASE_PF_NOMES
;
quit;

data BASE_MATRIZ_NOMES;
retain cont 0;
set BASE_PF_NOMES;
cont=cont+1;
run;

proc sql noprint;
	select
		 TabelaMatriz into :TabelaMatriz
	from BASE_MATRIZ_NOMES
	where cont =1;
;
quit;

DATA BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL(KEEP=ATUALIZACAO DOC_NUM NOME riscoMatriz SCORE_LISTA_FIM SCORE_COAF_FIM SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM
                       SCORE_ALERTA6M_FIM SCORE_ESPECIE_FIM SCORE_PEP_FIM REF FILTRO);
SET PLD.&TabelaMatriz.(WHERE=(riscoMatriz = 3));
RUN;

proc sql noprint;
        select distinct (MAX(cont)) into :Qtd_  from BASE_MATRIZ_NOMES;
quit;
%put &Qtd_;

%macro MATRIZ;
%do x=2 %to &Qtd_.;

proc sql noprint;
	select
		 TabelaMatriz into :TabelaMatriz
	from BASE_MATRIZ_NOMES
	where cont =&x.;
;
quit;

DATA BASE_MATRIZ(KEEP=ATUALIZACAO DOC_NUM NOME riscoMatriz SCORE_LISTA_FIM SCORE_COAF_FIM SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM
                       SCORE_ALERTA6M_FIM SCORE_ESPECIE_FIM SCORE_PEP_FIM REF FILTRO);
SET PLD.&TabelaMatriz.(WHERE=(riscoMatriz = 3));
run;

DATA BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL;
SET BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL BASE_MATRIZ ;
RUN;

%end;
%mend;
%MATRIZ;

PROC SORT DATA=BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL; BY _ALL_;
PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL ; TABLES ATUALIZACAO; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL AS
		SELECT DISTINCT
                T1.*,
                YEAR(t1.ATUALIZACAO)*100 + MONTH(t1.ATUALIZACAO) AS ANOMES,
				T3.LOTE

	FROM BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL T1
	LEFT JOIN WORK.DEPARA_LOTES T3 ON (YEAR(t1.ATUALIZACAO)*100 + MONTH(t1.ATUALIZACAO) = T3.ANOMES)
    WHERE t1.FILTRO IN ('AGUARDANDO DIMENSA','DERIVA','LISTA_FRAUDES')
;
QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL; BY DOC_NUM DESCENDING ANOMES;RUN;
PROC SORT DATA=BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL NODUPKEY; BY DOC_NUM NOME SCORE_COAF SCORE_CAMBIO SCORE_ALERTA6M SCORE_LISTA SCORE_PEP SCORE_ESPECIE;RUN;


  PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_FILTRO_2_PF AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.DOC_NUM,
		  T1.LOTE,
          (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_COAF_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_COAF' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_COAF,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_CAMBIO' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_ALERTA6M' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_ALERTA6M,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_LISTA_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_LISTA' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_LISTA,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_PEP_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_PEP' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_PEP,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_ESPECIE_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_ESPECIE' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_ESPECIE

      FROM BASE_MATRIZ_FINAL t1
;QUIT;

 PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_FILTRO_2_PF AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.DOC_NUM,
		  T1.LOTE,
          COMPRESS(CATX(' ',t1.SCORE_COAF,'',t1.SCORE_CAMBIO,'',t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M,'',t1.SCORE_LISTA,'',
				             t1.SCORE_PEP,'',T1.SCORE_ESPECIE,''))  FORMAT $150. AS DescAlertas

      FROM BS_FILTRO_2_PF t1
;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_FILTRO_2_PF;table DescAlertas /nopercent nocum;RUN;



PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_FILTRO_COUNT AS
	SELECT *,
           Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_FILTRO_2_PF
GROUP BY DOC_NUM,LOTE
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;





 
  PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_FIM_DESC AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_COAF_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_COAF' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_COAF,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_CAMBIO' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_ALERTA6M' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_ALERTA6M,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_LISTA_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_LISTA' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_LISTA,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_PEP_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_PEP' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_PEP,
		  (CASE WHEN (t1.SCORE_ESPECIE_FIM)> 0 THEN 'SCORE_ESPECIE' ELSE '' END) AS SCORE_ESPECIE

      FROM BS_PF_FIM t1
	  WHERE T1.riscoMatriz = 3
;QUIT;

 PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_FIM_DESC AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.DOC_NUM,
		   COMPRESS(CATX(' ',t1.SCORE_COAF,'',t1.SCORE_CAMBIO,'',t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M,'',t1.SCORE_LISTA,'',
				             t1.SCORE_PEP,'',T1.SCORE_ESPECIE,''))  FORMAT $150. AS DescAlertas

      FROM BS_PF_FIM_DESC t1
;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PF_FIM_DESC;table DescAlertas /nopercent nocum;RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_FINAL_FILTRO AS
   SELECT t1.DOC_NUM,

          (CASE WHEN T1.ELEGIVEL IN ('BLOQUEADO','ENCERRADO_MONITORAMENTO','BLOQUEADO KYC') THEN t1.ELEGIVEL

				

                WHEN T1.riscoMatriz IN (1,2) THEN 'RENOVACAO AUTOMATICA'

				
 				WHEN T1.riscoMatriz = 3 AND T2.DOC_NUM IS NOT MISSING THEN 'FILTRO 1'
				WHEN T1.riscoMatriz = 3 AND T4.CPFCNPJ IS NOT MISSING THEN 'MONITORAMENTO_2NIVEL'

				WHEN T1.riscoMatriz = 3 AND (T3.DescAlertas = T5.DescAlertas) THEN 'FILTRO_2'

				

		        ELSE 'DERIVA' END) FORMAT $char100. AS FILTRO

      FROM BS_PF_FIM t1
	  LEFT JOIN BS_FILTRO_1 T2 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T2.DOC_NUM)
      LEFT JOIN BS_FILTRO_2_PF T3 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T3.DOC_NUM)
	  LEFT JOIN FILTRO_MONITORMENTO_COMUNICA T4 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = INPUT(T4.CPFCNPJ,BEST14.))
	  LEFT JOIN BS_PF_FIM_DESC T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T5.DOC_NUM)

;QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PF_FINAL_FILTRO NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PF_FINAL_FILTRO ; TABLES FILTRO; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_360_COUNT AS
	SELECT *,
           Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_PF_FINAL_FILTRO
GROUP BY DOC_NUM,FILTRO
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_FINAL_&REF. AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
			t1.*,
            T2.FILTRO

      FROM BS_PF_FIM t1
	  LEFT JOIN BS_PF_FINAL_FILTRO T2 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T2.DOC_NUM)

;QUIT;

  

proc delete data=PLD.BS_PF_FINAL_&REF.; run;
proc delete data=PLD.BS_360_PILARESRISCO; run;

DATA PLD.BS_PF_FINAL_&REF.;
SET BS_PF_FINAL_&REF.;
FORMAT ATUALIZACAO DATE9.;
ATUALIZACAO = TODAY();
RUN;



  PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PF_TOTAL AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		  COMPRESS(CATX(' ',T1.DOC_RELA,t1.NuCpfCnpj,YEAR(T1.ATUALIZACAO)*10000+MONTH(T1.ATUALIZACAO)*100+DAY(T1.ATUALIZACAO))) AS chaveID

      FROM PLD.BS_PF_FINAL_&REF. t1

;QUIT;

 PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_360_COUNT AS
	SELECT chaveID,
	       Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_PF_TOTAL
GROUP BY chaveID
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;

/* =========================FIM TASK=========================== */
/* TASK: Pessoa Fisica */
/* ORDEM EXECUÇÃO: 005 */
/* =========================FIM TASK=========================== */

/* =========================INÍCIO TASK========================= */
/* TASK: Arruma base PJ */
/* ORDEM EXECUÇÃO: 006 */
/* FLUXO: PFD Flow 267 */
/* ORDEM: Sequencial (Topological Sort) */
/* NOME DO NÓ: Arruma base PJ */
/* TIPO: SAS Program */
/* ARQUIVO FONTE: CodeTask-MPOyNRdXRN8FHBKf/code.sas */
/* =========================INÍCIO TASK========================= */
PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_360_FINAL_PJ AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          (CASE WHEN t1.NuCpfCnpj = '10272489000105' THEN '10272489000104'
                WHEN t1.NuCpfCnpj = '26011340012460' THEN '02601134001246'
                ELSE t1.NuCpfCnpj END) AS NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          t1.FL_TIPO,
          T1.NUCONSULTADO,
          INPUT((CASE WHEN t1.NuCpfCnpj = '10272489000105' THEN '10272489000104'
                WHEN t1.NuCpfCnpj = '26011340012460' THEN '02601134001246'
                ELSE t1.NuCpfCnpj END),BEST14.) FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM,
          t1.CNAE,
          t1.ESTEIRA_NOVA  FORMAT $50. AS ESTEIRA,
          t1.ELEGIVEL,
          T2.VISAO_360,
		  t2.NUM_KYC,
		  INPUT(SUBSTR(t1.NUCONSULTADO,1,8),BEST14.) FORMAT BEST14. AS GRUPO,
		  (CASE WHEN t1.FL_TIPO = 'DOCUMENTO' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS FLAG

      FROM BS_QSA_FINAL_QSA t1
	  LEFT JOIN PLD.BS_360_FINAL T2 ON (T1.NUCpfCnpj = T2.NUCpfCnpj)

      ;
QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_360_FINAL_PJ; BY NuCpfCnpj NUCONSULTADO FLAG;RUN;
PROC SORT DATA=BS_360_FINAL_PJ NODUPKEY; BY NuCpfCnpj NUCONSULTADO;RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FINAL_PJ;TABLES FL_QSA/nopercent nocum ; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FINAL_PJ;TABLES ELEGIVEL/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FINAL_PJ;TABLES ESTEIRA/nopercent nocum ; RUN ;



PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE COUNT_QSA_F AS
	SELECT DISTINCT
    *,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_360_FINAL_PJ
GROUP BY NuCpfCnpj,NUCONSULTADO
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;



DATA BASE_QSA_DEMAIS BASE_FINAL_BV;
	SET BS_360_FINAL_PJ;
	DROP FLAG;
	IF ELEGIVEL IN ('GRUPO_VOTORANTIM','FUNDO_VAM') THEN OUTPUT BASE_FINAL_BV;
    ELSE OUTPUT BASE_QSA_DEMAIS;
RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_QSA_DEMAIS;TABLES ELEGIVEL/nopercent nocum; RUN;
PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_FINAL_BV;TABLES ELEGIVEL/nopercent nocum; RUN;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_360_FINAL_PJ;TABLES ELEGIVEL/nopercent nocum; RUN;



PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ABERTURA_QSA AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		  t2.DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          TRIM(LEFT(UPPER(COMPRESS(t2.NOME_QUADRO,"0123456789.+-*/,;?:°<>^~}]´`{[ª!@#$%&()_§|\")))) AS NOME_QUADRO,
		  T2.TP_QUADRO,
		  (CASE WHEN t4.CdCNPJ IS NOT MISSING  THEN 'GRUPO_VOTORANTIM'
				WHEN t3.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING THEN 'GRUPO_VOTORANTIM'
				ELSE T1.FL_QSA END) FORMAT $50. AS FL_QSA1,
          t2.Fl_QSA_Fundo,
          t2.Fl_Principal_Fundos,
		  '' AS NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR,
		  '' as STATUS_ADM_GESTOR,
          '' as SIT_CVM

      FROM BASE_QSA_DEMAIS t1
	  LEFT JOIN BS_QSA_FINAL_F T2 ON (T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCONSULTADO)
	  LEFT JOIN BS_ADM_VAM t4 ON (t2.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = INPUT(t4.CdCNPJ,BEST14.))
	  LEFT JOIN BS_RELACIONADA t3 ON (t2.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = t3.NuCpfCnpj)
;quit;



DATA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO (WHERE=(Fl_Principal_Fundos = 1 AND Fl_QSA_Fundo = 0));
SET BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
DROP SIT_CVM;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		  (CASE WHEN t5.SIT_CALC IS MISSING THEN 'NAO ENCONTRADO NA CVM' ELSE  t5.SIT_CALC END) AS SIT_CVM

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO t1
	  LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T5.docConsultado)

;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          t1.FL_TIPO,
          t1.NUCONSULTADO,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          t1.CNAE,
          t1.ESTEIRA,
          t1.ELEGIVEL,
          t1.VISAO_360,
          t1.NUM_KYC,
          t1.GRUPO,
          t1.FL_QSA1,
          t1.Fl_QSA_Fundo,
          t1.Fl_Principal_Fundos,
		  t1.SIT_CVM,
		  t5.docADMIN FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          UPPER(COMPRESS(t5.ADMIN,"0123456789.+-*/,;?:°<>^~}]´`{[ª!@#$%&()_§|\")) AS NOME_QUADRO,
	      'GESTOR E ADM' FORMAT $50. AS TP_QUADRO,
	       t6.'KYC: Código'n AS NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR,
		  (CASE WHEN t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = 23025053000162 THEN 'N_ENCONTRADO'
                WHEN t6.Status = 'ativo' THEN 'ATIVO'
				WHEN T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO IS NOT MISSING THEN 'ATIVO'
                WHEN t6.Status IS MISSING THEN 'N_ENCONTRADO' ELSE 'N_ATIVO' end) as STATUS_ADM_GESTOR

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO t1
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T5.docConsultado)
			LEFT JOIN BS_ADM_VAM t4 ON (T5.docADMIN = INPUT(t4.CdCNPJ,BEST14.))
	  	    LEFT JOIN BS_RELACIONADA t3 ON (T5.docADMIN = t3.NuCpfCnpj)
			LEFT JOIN BS_SALES_FIM T6 ON (T6.DOC_NUM = T5.docADMIN)
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_ESTUDO T8 ON (T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docADMIN)
			WHERE T5.docADMIN > 0 AND T5.docADMIN IS NOT MISSING

UNION ALL

   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          t1.FL_TIPO,
          t1.NUCONSULTADO,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          t1.CNAE,
          t1.ESTEIRA,
          t1.ELEGIVEL,
          t1.VISAO_360,
          t1.NUM_KYC,
          t1.GRUPO,
          t1.FL_QSA1,
          t1.Fl_QSA_Fundo,
          t1.Fl_Principal_Fundos,
		  t1.SIT_CVM,
		  t5.docGESTOR FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          UPPER(COMPRESS(t5.GESTOR,"0123456789.+-*/,;?:°<>^~}]´`{[ª!@#$%&()_§|\")) AS NOME_QUADRO,
	      'GESTOR E ADM' FORMAT $50. AS TP_QUADRO,
		  t6.'KYC: Código'n AS NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR,
		  (CASE WHEN t6.Status = 'ativo' THEN 'ATIVO'
		        WHEN T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO IS NOT MISSING THEN 'ATIVO'
                WHEN t6.Status IS MISSING THEN 'N_ENCONTRADO' ELSE 'N_ATIVO' end) as STATUS_ADM_GESTOR

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO t1
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T5.docConsultado)
			LEFT JOIN BS_ADM_VAM t4 ON (t5.docGESTOR = INPUT(t4.CdCNPJ,BEST14.))
	  	    LEFT JOIN BS_RELACIONADA t3 ON (t5.docGESTOR = t3.NuCpfCnpj)
			LEFT JOIN BS_SALES_FIM T6 ON (T6.DOC_NUM = T5.docGESTOR) AND T5.docGESTOR IS NOT MISSING
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_ESTUDO T8 ON (T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docGESTOR)
			;
QUIT;



DATA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS (WHERE=(Fl_QSA_Fundo = 1 AND Fl_Principal_Fundos = 0));
SET BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
DROP SIT_CVM;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS_SIT AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		  (CASE WHEN t5.SIT_CALC IS MISSING THEN 'NAO ENCONTRADO NA CVM' ELSE  t5.SIT_CALC END) AS SIT_CVM

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS t1
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docConsultado)

;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          t1.FL_TIPO,
          t1.NUCONSULTADO,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          t1.CNAE,
          t1.ESTEIRA,
          t1.ELEGIVEL,
          t1.VISAO_360,
          t1.NUM_KYC,
          t1.GRUPO,
          t1.FL_QSA1,
          t1.Fl_QSA_Fundo,
          t1.Fl_Principal_Fundos,
		  '' AS SIT_CVM,
		  t5.docADMIN FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          UPPER(COMPRESS(t5.ADMIN,"0123456789.+-*/,;?:°<>^~}]´`{[ª!@#$%&()_§|\")) AS NOME_QUADRO,
	      'GESTOR E ADM' FORMAT $50. AS TP_QUADRO,
	       t6.'KYC: Código'n AS NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR,
		  (CASE WHEN t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = 23025053000162 THEN 'N_ENCONTRADO'
                WHEN t6.Status = 'ativo' THEN 'ATIVO'
				WHEN T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO IS NOT MISSING THEN 'ATIVO'
                WHEN t6.Status IS MISSING THEN 'N_ENCONTRADO' ELSE 'N_ATIVO' end) as STATUS_ADM_GESTOR

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS_SIT t1
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docConsultado)
			LEFT JOIN BS_ADM_VAM t4 ON (T5.docADMIN = INPUT(t4.CdCNPJ,BEST14.))
	  	    LEFT JOIN BS_RELACIONADA t3 ON (T5.docADMIN = t3.NuCpfCnpj)
			LEFT JOIN BS_SALES_FIM T6 ON (T6.DOC_NUM = T5.docADMIN  AND T5.docGESTOR IS NOT MISSING)
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_ESTUDO T8 ON (T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docADMIN)
			WHERE t1.SIT_CVM NOT = 'NAO ENCONTRADO NA CVM'

UNION ALL

   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          t1.FL_TIPO,
          t1.NUCONSULTADO,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          t1.CNAE,
          t1.ESTEIRA,
          t1.ELEGIVEL,
          t1.VISAO_360,
          t1.NUM_KYC,
          t1.GRUPO,
          t1.FL_QSA1,
          t1.Fl_QSA_Fundo,
          t1.Fl_Principal_Fundos,
		  '' AS SIT_CVM,
		  t5.docGESTOR FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          UPPER(COMPRESS(t5.GESTOR,"0123456789.+-*/,;?:°<>^~}]´`{[ª!@#$%&()_§|\")) AS NOME_QUADRO,
	      'GESTOR E ADM' FORMAT $50. AS TP_QUADRO,
		  t6.'KYC: Código'n AS NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR,
		  (CASE WHEN t6.Status = 'ativo' THEN 'ATIVO'
		        WHEN T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO IS NOT MISSING THEN 'ATIVO'
                WHEN t6.Status IS MISSING THEN 'N_ENCONTRADO' ELSE 'N_ATIVO' end) as STATUS_ADM_GESTOR

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS_SIT t1
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_CADASTRO_ATIVO T5 ON (T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docConsultado)
			LEFT JOIN BS_ADM_VAM t4 ON (t5.docGESTOR = INPUT(t4.CdCNPJ,BEST14.))
	  	    LEFT JOIN BS_RELACIONADA t3 ON (t5.docGESTOR = t3.NuCpfCnpj)
			LEFT JOIN BS_SALES_FIM T6 ON (T6.DOC_NUM = T5.docGESTOR AND T5.docGESTOR IS NOT MISSING)
			LEFT JOIN BS_FUNDOS_ESTUDO T8 ON (T8.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T5.docGESTOR)
			WHERE t1.SIT_CVM NOT = 'NAO ENCONTRADO NA CVM'
			;
QUIT;

DATA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
SET BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
if Fl_Principal_Fundos = 1 AND Fl_QSA_Fundo = 0 then delete;
RUN;

DATA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
SET BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
if Fl_QSA_Fundo = 1 AND Fl_Principal_Fundos = 0 then delete;
RUN;

DATA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
FORMAT NUM_KYC $100.;
FORMAT STATUS_ADM_GESTOR $100.;
FORMAT NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR $100.;
FORMAT SIT_CVM $20.;
SET BASE_ABERTURA_QSA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPALFUNDO BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_FUNDOS_SIT;
RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BASE_ABERTURA_QSA NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_; RUN;





PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPAL AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          t1.NOME,
          t1.FL_QSA,
          t1.FL_TIPO,
          t1.NUCONSULTADO,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          t1.CNAE,
          t1.ESTEIRA,
          t1.ELEGIVEL,
          t1.VISAO_360,
          t1.NUM_KYC,
          t1.GRUPO,
          t1.FL_QSA1,
          (CASE WHEN t2.Fl_Principal_Fundos = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Fl_QSA_Fundo,
          t2.Fl_Principal_Fundos,
          '' AS NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR,
          '' AS STATUS_ADM_GESTOR,
          '' as SIT_CVM,
          t1.DOC_NUM FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM_QUADRO,
          UPPER(COMPRESS(t1.NOME,"0123456789.+-*/,;?:°<>^~}]´`{[ª!@#$%&()_§|\")) AS NOME_QUADRO,
	      (CASE WHEN T1.FL_TIPO = 'RAIZ' THEN 'PRINCIPAL_RAIZ' ELSE 'PRINCIPAL' END) FORMAT $100. AS TP_QUADRO

      FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA t1
	  LEFT JOIN BASE_ABERTURA_QSA T2 ON (T1.NuCpfCnpj = T2.NuCpfCnpj AND T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCONSULTADO)

;QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPAL NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_; RUN;

DATA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA;
FORMAT TP_QUADRO $100.;
FORMAT NUM_KYC $100.;
FORMAT STATUS_ADM_GESTOR $100.;
FORMAT NUM_KYC_ADM_GESTOR $100.;
FORMAT SIT_CVM $20.;
SET BASE_ABERTURA_QSA BASE_ABERTURA_QSA_PRINCIPAL;
RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BASE_ABERTURA_QSA NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_; RUN;

		         WHEN FL_QSA1 IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA',
					                      'SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO') THEN 2
                 ELSE 3 END) AS FL
   FROM BASE_ABERTURA_QSA t1
      WHERE FL_QSA1 NOT='NADA';

 PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_PJ_QSA_1 AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		 (CASE WHEN T2.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING AND T1.TP_QUADRO IN ('DIRETORIA') THEN 'DIR/PROCURADOR'
		       WHEN T2.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING AND T1.TP_QUADRO IN ('SOCIO PF') THEN 'PROCURADOR'
			   WHEN T2.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING AND T1.TP_QUADRO IN ('RESPONSAVEL') THEN 'PROCURADOR'
			   WHEN T3.NuCpfCnpj IS NOT MISSING AND T1.TP_QUADRO IN ('FUNDO') THEN T3.TP_QUADRO
		       ELSE T1.TP_QUADRO END) FORMAT $150. AS TP_QUADRO1

      FROM BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM t1
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT t1.NuCpfCnpj,t1.NUCONSULTADO,t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO
                 FROM BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM t1 WHERE t1.TP_QUADRO = 'PROCURADOR' )T2
				ON (T1.NuCpfCnpj = T2.NuCpfCnpj AND T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCONSULTADO AND T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T2.DOC_NUM_QUADRO)
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT t1.NuCpfCnpj,t1.NUCONSULTADO,t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO,t1.TP_QUADRO
                 FROM BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM t1 WHERE t1.TP_QUADRO = 'GESTOR E ADM' )T3
				ON (T1.NuCpfCnpj = T2.NuCpfCnpj AND T1.NUCONSULTADO = T3.NUCONSULTADO AND T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T3.DOC_NUM_QUADRO)
      WHERE t1.TP_QUADRO NOT IN ('PROCURADOR','GESTOR E ADM')
;QUIT;

DATA BASE_PJ_QSA_1;
SET BASE_PJ_QSA_1;
DROP TP_QUADRO;
RENAME TP_QUADRO1 = TP_QUADRO;
RUN;

 PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_PJ_QSA_OUTROS AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*

      FROM BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM t1
	  LEFT JOIN BASE_PJ_QSA_1 T2 ON (T1.NuCpfCnpj = T2.NuCpfCnpj AND T1.NUCONSULTADO = T2.NUCONSULTADO AND T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T2.DOC_NUM_QUADRO)
	  WHERE t1.TP_QUADRO IN ('PROCURADOR','GESTOR E ADM') AND T2.TP_QUADRO IS MISSING
;QUIT;

DATA BASE_PJ_QSA_FINAL;
SET BASE_PJ_QSA_OUTROS BASE_PJ_QSA_1;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_NOMES_PJ AS
		SELECT DISTINCT
    	DOC_NUM,
		NOME

	FROM BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM
	WHERE NOME IS NOT MISSING

UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT
    	COALESCE(DOC_NUM_QUADRO,0) FORMAT BEST14. AS DOC_NUM,
		NOME_QUADRO AS NOME

	FROM BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM
	WHERE NOME_QUADRO IS NOT MISSING
;QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_NOMES_PJ NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_;RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM ; TABLES FL_QSA ELEGIVEL/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

DATA BASE_FUNDOS_LISTAS BASE_FINAL_BV2 BS_FALTA_ABERTURA BASE_PJ_QSA;
	SET BASE_PJ_QSA_FIM;
	IF FL_QSA IN ('GRUPO_VOTORANTIM','FUNDO_VAM','GRUPO_BV') THEN OUTPUT BASE_FINAL_BV2;
	IF ELEGIVEL IN ('FUNDO N EXCLUSIVO') AND FL_QSA NOT IN ('GRUPO_VOTORANTIM','FUNDO_VAM','GRUPO_BV') THEN OUTPUT BASE_FUNDOS_LISTAS;
	IF FL_QSA IN ('FALTA_ABERTURA','S/INFO','SA - FALTA ABERTURA','SA FECHADA')
       AND ELEGIVEL NOT IN ('FUNDO N EXCLUSIVO') THEN OUTPUT BS_FALTA_ABERTURA;
    IF FL_QSA IN ('ABERTO','ABERTO - DISPENSADO','ABERTO_1QSA','ABERTO_SA','ESTRANGEIRO','FALTA DIRETORIA SA',
                  'FUNDO','SA FECHADA COM PARTICIPACAO') AND ELEGIVEL NOT IN ('FUNDO N EXCLUSIVO') THEN OUTPUT BASE_PJ_QSA;
RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_FUNDOS_LISTAS ; TABLES FL_QSA/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_PJ_CNAE AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
         t1.*,
		 t3.Grupo AS GRUPO_CNAE,
		 tranwrd(t3.'DESCRIÇAO'n, ';', ',') as DESCRICAO,
		 (CASE WHEN T3.'Risco 2'n = 'Extremo' THEN 27
		  		WHEN T3.'Risco 2'n = 'Alto' THEN 9
				WHEN T3.'Risco 2'n = 'Médio' THEN 3
				WHEN T3.'Risco 2'n = 'Baixo' THEN 0 ELSE 27 END) AS SCORE_CNAE

      FROM BASE_PJ_QSA t1
      LEFT JOIN de_para_cnae T3 ON (T1.CNAE = t3.'CNAE FISCAL 2#2'n)
      ;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BASE_PJ_CNAE ; TABLES SCORE_CNAE/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

;

;
QUIT;

%if Count = > 1  %then %do;

%end;
%put  A condição é falsa. A execução continuar;
;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_COAF_PJ AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN B.QTDE IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.QTDE END) AS QTDE_COAF,
            (CASE WHEN B.QTDE >=3 THEN 27
                  WHEN B.QTDE =2 THEN 9
                  WHEN B.QTDE =1 THEN 3
                  WHEN B.QTDE IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_COAF

FROM BASE_PJ_CNAE A LEFT JOIN BS_COAF_FINAL_36 B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = B.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_COAF_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_COAF/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_COAF_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_COAF*QTDE_COAF/nopercent nocum; RUN ;







PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_J AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
		  *,
          input(Compress(NR_CGC_CPF),14.) FORMAT=BEST16. AS DOC_NUM,
		  input(Compress(IdPais_Contraparte),8.) FORMAT=BEST12. AS IdPais

      FROM BASE_CAMBIO_FINAL t1
        WHERE t1.TPPESSOA = 'J';
               ;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_J AS
   SELECT t1.*,
          (CASE WHEN T1.MODALIDADE_PAGAMENTO = 'PAGTO ANTECIPADO FIN' THEN 1
                WHEN T1.MODALIDADE_PAGAMENTO = 'Pagamento Antecipado' THEN 1
					 ELSE 0 END) AS PGTO_ANTECIPADO,
          (CASE WHEN t2.PAIS IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS PAISES_PROIBIDO
      FROM BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_J t1
           LEFT JOIN PLD.PAISES_RESTRITOS t2 ON (t1.IdPais = t2.CD_BACEN);
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PAISES_J AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NR_CGC_CPF,
          COMPRESS(t1.DsPais_CONTRAPARTE) AS DsPais_CONTRAPARTE,
		  t1.IdPais

      FROM BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_J t1
      WHERE t1.PAISES_PROIBIDO = 1;
QUIT;

DATA BS_CONCAT_J;
SET BS_PAISES_J;
FORMAT DSPAIS_SANCIONADO $char100.;
RETAIN DSPAIS_SANCIONADO;
	IF FIRST.NR_CGC_CPF then DSPAIS_SANCIONADO = '';
BY NR_CGC_CPF;
DSPAIS_SANCIONADO = CATX(' ',DsPais_CONTRAPARTE,DSPAIS_SANCIONADO);
IF LAST.NR_CGC_CPF;

DROP DsPais_CONTRAPARTE;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_PJ_CAMBIO_FIM AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NR_CGC_CPF,
          t1.DOC_NUM,
          (SUM(t1.VL_MN)) FORMAT=BEST12. AS VL_MN,
          (COUNT(t1.NR_CGC_CPF)) AS QTDE,
           SUM(t1.PAISES_PROIBIDO) AS QTPAISES_SANCIONADOS,
          (SUM(t1.PGTO_ANTECIPADO)/(COUNT(t1.NR_CGC_CPF))) FORMAT percent10.0 AS PGTO_ANTECIPADO,
		  (SUM(t1.PAISES_PROIBIDO)/(COUNT(t1.NR_CGC_CPF))) FORMAT percent10.0 AS PAISES_SANCIONADOS,
          t2.DSPAIS_SANCIONADO

      FROM BASE_FULL_CAMBIO_J t1
	  	LEFT JOIN BS_CONCAT_J t2 ON (T1.NR_CGC_CPF = T2.NR_CGC_CPF)
      		GROUP BY t1.NR_CGC_CPF,
               		 t1.DOC_NUM;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_CAMBIO_PJ AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.VL_MN END)
								FORMAT BEST12. AS VL_MN,
			(CASE WHEN B.PGTO_ANTECIPADO IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.PGTO_ANTECIPADO END)
								FORMAT percent10.0 AS PGTO_ANTECIPADO,
			(CASE WHEN B.PAISES_SANCIONADOS IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.PAISES_SANCIONADOS END)
								FORMAT percent10.0 AS PAISES_SANCIONADOS,
		    (CASE WHEN A.CNAE IN (6470101,6470102,6422100,6431000) THEN 0
                  WHEN A.GRUPO_CNAE = 'C' THEN
                   	(CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0
                 		  WHEN B.VL_MN < 112000000 THEN 3
                  		  WHEN B.VL_MN >= 112000000 THEN 9
                   				ELSE 1 END)
			      WHEN A.GRUPO_CNAE = 'G' THEN
                   	(CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0
                 		  WHEN B.VL_MN < 136000000 THEN 3
                  		  WHEN B.VL_MN >= 136000000 THEN 9
                   				ELSE 1 END)
			      WHEN A.GRUPO_CNAE = 'K' THEN
                   	(CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0
                 		  WHEN B.VL_MN < 283000000 THEN 3
                  		  WHEN B.VL_MN >= 283000000 THEN 9
                   				ELSE 1 END)
				  	ELSE
						(CASE WHEN B.VL_MN IS MISSING THEN 0
                 		  WHEN B.VL_MN < 50000000 THEN 3
                  		  WHEN B.VL_MN >= 50000000 THEN 9
                   				ELSE 1 END)END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO_INI

FROM BS_COAF_PJ A LEFT JOIN BASE_PJ_CAMBIO_FIM B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM = B.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_CAMBIO_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_CAMBIO_INI/nopercent nocum; RUN;





PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_CAMBIO_PJ AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 OR A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO > 0.20) AND
						A.SCORE_CAMBIO_INI = 9 THEN 27
				  WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 OR A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO > 0.20) AND
						A.SCORE_CAMBIO_INI = 3 THEN 9
                  		ELSE A.SCORE_CAMBIO_INI END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM,
			(CASE WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 AND A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO > 0.20) THEN 'UPGRADE POR AMBOS'
				  WHEN  A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS > 0 THEN 'UPGRADE POR PAISES SANCIONADOS'
				  WHEN  A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO >0.20 THEN 'UPGRADE POR PTO ANTECIPADO'
				  WHEN (A.PAISES_SANCIONADOS < 0 OR A.PGTO_ANTECIPADO <= 0.20) THEN 'SEM UPGRADE'
                  		ELSE 'SEM CAMBIO' END) AS UPGRADE_CAMBIO,
			B.DSPAIS_SANCIONADO

FROM BS_CAMBIO_PJ A LEFT JOIN BASE_PJ_CAMBIO_FIM B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM = B.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_CAMBIO_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM*SCORE_CAMBIO_INI/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

DATA BS_CAMBIO_PJ;
SET BS_CAMBIO_PJ;
DROP SCORE_CAMBIO_INI;
RENAME SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM = SCORE_CAMBIO;
RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_CAMBIO_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_CAMBIO/nopercent nocum; RUN ;




;
;
;


PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_ALERTA_PJ AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN B.QTDE_ALERTAS IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.QTDE_ALERTAS END) AS QTDE_ALERTAS,
			(CASE WHEN B.SCORE_PRODUTO IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.SCORE_PRODUTO END) AS SCORE_PRODUTOS,

			(CASE WHEN B.SCORE_ALERTA6M IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE B.SCORE_ALERTA6M END) AS SCORE_ALERTA6M

FROM BS_CAMBIO_PJ A LEFT JOIN BS_360_ALERTA B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM = B.CPFCNPJ);
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_ALERTA_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_ALERTA6M/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_LISTAS_PJ AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
		  	t1.*,
		  	COALESCE(T2.CEIS,0) AS LISTA_CEIS,
			COALESCE(T2.TRAB_ESCRAVO,0) AS LISTA_TRAB_ESCRAVO,
			COALESCE(T2.MIDIA,0) AS LISTA_MIDIA,
			COALESCE(T2.CNEP,0) AS LISTA_CNEP,
			COALESCE(T2.LENIENCIA,0) AS LISTA_LENIENCIA,
			COALESCE(T2.CEPIM,0) AS LISTA_CEPIM,
			(CASE WHEN COALESCE(T2.RECUSADOS,0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LISTA_RECUSA,
			COALESCE(T2.MONITORAMENTO_PLD,0) AS LISTA_MONITORA_PLD,
			COALESCE(T2.DENUNCIA,0) AS LISTA_DENUNCIA,
			COALESCE(T2.OUTROS,0) AS LISTA_OUTROS,
			COALESCE(T2.LISTA_FRAUDES,0) AS LISTA_FRAUDES,
			COALESCE(T2.Fav_Bloqueado,0) AS LISTA_FAV_BLOQUEADO,
			COALESCE(T2.BLOQ_ONEPLD,0) AS LISTA_BLOQ_ONEPLD,
			COALESCE(T2.RENOVACAO,0) AS LISTA_RENOVACAO

   FROM BS_ALERTA_PJ t1
   LEFT JOIN LISTA_BLOQUEADOS T2 ON (T1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = T2.DOC_NUM);

QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_LISTAS_PJ AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			*,
			(CASE WHEN (LISTA_CEIS + LISTA_TRAB_ESCRAVO +
                        LISTA_MIDIA + LISTA_CNEP + LISTA_LENIENCIA + LISTA_CEPIM +
                        LISTA_RECUSA + LISTA_MONITORA_PLD + LISTA_DENUNCIA + LISTA_OUTROS +
                        LISTA_FRAUDES + LISTA_FAV_BLOQUEADO + LISTA_BLOQ_ONEPLD +
                        LISTA_RENOVACAO) = 0
					THEN 0 ELSE 27 END) AS SCORE_LISTA

FROM BS_LISTAS_PJ
 ;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_LISTA/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_RECUSA/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_LENIENCIA/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_CNEP/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_CEPIM/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_CEIS/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_TRAB_ESCRAVO/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_MIDIA/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_MONITORA_PLD/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_OUTROS/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_FRAUDES/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_FAV_BLOQUEADO/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_BLOQ_ONEPLD/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_LISTAS_PJ ; TABLES LISTA_RENOVACAO/nopercent nocum; RUN ;





















DATA BS_PEP_FULL;
SET PLD.BS_PEP_FULL;
RUN;



PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PEP_FULL_MUNI AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
         	 t1.Nome_PEP,
         	 t1.GrauRelacionamento,
          	 (CASE WHEN T2.UF IS MISSING THEN t1.UF ELSE T2.UF END) AS UF,
		 	 (CASE WHEN T2.MUNICIPIO IS MISSING THEN t1.MUNICIPIO ELSE T2.MUNICIPIO END) AS MUNICIPIO,
	          t1.DOC_NUM,
         	  t1.NmCargo,
          	  t1.LISTA,
       		  t1.Dt_Inicio_Exercicio,
         	  t1.Dt_Fim_Exercicio,
         	  t1.Dt_Final_Carencia,
        	  t1.NmOrgao,
        	  t1.VIGENTE

      FROM BS_PEP_FULL t1
           LEFT JOIN DE_PARA_CARGOS t2 ON (t1.NmOrgao = t2.NmOrgao)
     ;
QUIT;



PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_MUNICIPIOS AS
		SELECT DISTINCT
	 		UF,
	 		('NOME DO MUNICiPIO'n) AS MUNICIPIO,
	 		RISCO_1

	FROM Municipios;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_PEP_SCORE AS
	SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN A.NmCargo = 'S/INFO' THEN 27
			      WHEN A.NmCargo NOT= 'S/INFO' AND A.NmOrgao IS MISSING THEN 27
                  WHEN B.Risco = 'Altissimo' THEN 27
			      WHEN B.Risco = 'Alto' THEN 9
                  WHEN B.Risco in ( 'Médio','médio') THEN 3
				  WHEN B.Risco in ('Baixo','baixo') THEN 1
				  WHEN B.Risco in ('Sem definição com o governo') THEN 0
				  WHEN B.Risco IN ('todos','Todos')
                  THEN (CASE WHEN C.RISCO_1 = 'Altíssimo' THEN 27
						 	 WHEN C.RISCO_1 = 'ALTO' THEN 9
						 	 WHEN C.RISCO_1 in ( 'MÉDIO') THEN 3
						 	 WHEN C.RISCO_1 in ('BAIXO') THEN 1 ELSE 100 END) ELSE 100 END) AS SCORE_PEP_INI

	FROM BS_PEP_FULL_MUNI A
		LEFT JOIN De_Para_PEP B
 			ON (A.NmCargo = B.NmCargo) AND (A.NmOrgao = B.NmOrgao)
		LEFT JOIN BS_MUNICIPIOS C
 			ON (A.MUNICIPIO = C.MUNICIPIO) AND (A.UF = C.UF);
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_PEP_SCORE AS
	SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			(CASE WHEN A.GrauRelacionamento = 'PEP TITULAR' THEN A.SCORE_PEP_INI
				  ELSE (CASE WHEN SCORE_PEP_INI = 27 THEN 9
				  		     WHEN SCORE_PEP_INI = 9 THEN 3
							 WHEN SCORE_PEP_INI = 3 THEN 1
							 WHEN SCORE_PEP_INI = 0 THEN 0
							 WHEN SCORE_PEP_INI = 100 THEN 100
                             WHEN SCORE_PEP_INI = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)END) AS SCORE_PEP_FIM

	FROM BS_PEP_SCORE A
		;
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PEP_SCORE ; TABLES SCORE_PEP_INI*SCORE_PEP_FIM/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

DATA BS_PEP_SCORE;
SET BS_PEP_SCORE;
RENAME SCORE_PEP_FIM = SCORE_PEP;
RUN;



PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PEP_PJ AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          T1.*,
          (CASE WHEN T2.DOC_NUM IS MISSING THEN 'NÃO' ELSE 'SIM' END) AS PEP,
          COALESCE(T2.SCORE_PEP,0) AS SCORE_PEP,
		  t2.NmCargo AS CARGO_PEP,
		  t2.NmOrgao AS ORGAO_PEP,
		  t2.SCORE_PEP,
		  t2.UF,
		  t2.MUNICIPIO,
		  t2.GRAURELACIONAMENTO AS RELACAO_PEP

      FROM BS_LISTAS_PJ T1
      LEFT JOIN BS_PEP_SCORE t2 ON (t1.DOC_NUM_QUADRO = t2.DOC_NUM);
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PEP_PJ AS
   		SELECT DISTINCT
		  	t1.*,
		  (CASE WHEN T3.DOC_NUM IS NOT MISSING THEN 'SIM'
                WHEN T1.DOC_NUM = 0 AND T4.NOME IS NOT MISSING THEN 'SIM' ELSE T1.PEP END) AS PEP1,
		  (CASE WHEN T3.DOC_NUM IS NOT MISSING THEN 9
                WHEN T1.DOC_NUM = 0 AND T4.NOME IS NOT MISSING THEN 9 ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_PEPINTERNACIONAL,
		  (CASE WHEN T3.DOC_NUM IS NOT MISSING AND t1.CARGO_PEP IS NOT MISSING THEN
                CATX(' ',t1.CARGO_PEP,' e Match em PEP Internacional')
                WHEN T3.DOC_NUM IS NOT MISSING THEn 'Match em PEP Internacional'
				WHEN T4.NOME IS NOT MISSING AND t1.CARGO_PEP IS NOT MISSING THEN
                CATX(' ',t1.CARGO_PEP,' e Match em PEP Internacional')
                WHEN T4.NOME IS NOT MISSING THEn 'Match em PEP Internacional'
                ELSE t1.CARGO_PEP END) format $200. as CARGO_PEP1

   FROM BS_PEP_PJ t1
   LEFT JOIN WORK.'_Renovação_PJ__ConsultaSançõesPE'n T3 ON (T1.DOC_NUM = T3.DOC_NUM)
   LEFT JOIN WORK.'_Renovação_PJ__ConsultaSançõesPE'n T4 ON (T1.NOME = T4.NOME)
    ;

QUIT;

DATA BS_PEP_PJ;
SET BS_PEP_PJ;
DROP CARGO_PEP PEP;
RENAME CARGO_PEP1 = CARGO_PEP;
RENAME PEP1 = PEP;
RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PEP_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_PEP/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PEP_PJ ; TABLES PEP/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BASE_ANALISE AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.SCORE_PEP,
          t1.CARGO_PEP,
          t1.ORGAO_PEP,
          t1.UF,
          t1.MUNICIPIO,
          t1.RELACAO_PEP
      FROM BS_PEP_PJ t1
      WHERE t1.SCORE_PEP = 100;
QUIT;



DATA BASE_ANALISE;
SET BASE_ANALISE;
%if SCORE_PEP = 100  %then %do;
   %put A condição é verdadeira. A execução será interrompida;
    %abort cancel;
%end;
%put  A condição é falsa. A execução continuar;
;
RUN;

PROC SQL;
CREATE TABLE BS_ESPECIE_PJ AS
SELECT DISTINCT
			A.*,
			COALESCE(B.TOTAL,0) AS Vr_Especie,
			(CASE WHEN B.TOTAL IS MISSING THEN  'Sem Espécie'
                  WHEN B.TOTAL <10000 THEN  'Até 10 mil'
  				  WHEN B.TOTAL >=10000 AND B.TOTAL <20000 THEN 'de 10 a 20 mil'
  	    		  WHEN B.TOTAL >=20000 AND B.TOTAL <=50000 THEN 'de 20 a 50 mil'
		          	ELSE 'Acima de 50 mil' END) AS FAIXA_ESPECIE,
			(CASE WHEN B.TOTAL > 50000 THEN 27
			      WHEN B.TOTAL >=20000 AND B.TOTAL <=50000 THEN 9
                  WHEN B.TOTAL >=10000 AND B.TOTAL < 20000 THEN 3
				  	ELSE 0 END) AS SCORE_ESPECIE

FROM BS_PEP_PJ A LEFT JOIN BS_SAQUE_FIM B
	ON (A.DOC_NUM = INPUT(B.NuCpfCnpj,BEST14.));
QUIT;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_ESPECIE_PJ ; TABLES FAIXA_ESPECIE/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_ESPECIE_PJ ; TABLES SCORE_ESPECIE/nopercent nocum; RUN ;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_ESPECIE_PJ ; TABLES Vr_Especie/nopercent nocum; RUN ;



PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
          (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_COAF) END) AS SCORE_COAF,
		  (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_CAMBIO) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_CAMBIO) END) AS SCORE_CAMBIO,
          (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_ALERTA6M) END) AS SCORE_ALERTA6M,
          (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_LISTA) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_LISTA) END) AS SCORE_LISTA,
		  (CASE WHEN SUM(MAX(t1.SCORE_PEP),MAX(t1.SCORE_PEPINTERNACIONAL)) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_PEP,t1.SCORE_PEPINTERNACIONAL) END) AS SCORE_PEP,
          (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_ESPECIE) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_ESPECIE) END) AS SCORE_ESPECIE,
		  (CASE WHEN MAX(t1.SCORE_CNAE) IS MISSING THEN 0 ELSE MAX(t1.SCORE_CNAE) END) AS SCORE_CNAE,
		  (CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T1.STATUS_ADM_GESTOR IN ('N_ENCONTRADO','N_ATIVO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >0
                           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS LISTA_ADM_GESTOR

     FROM BS_ESPECIE_PJ t1
      GROUP BY t1.NuCpfCnpj

			;

QUIT;

DATA BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE;
SET BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE;
SCORE_FINAL = (SCORE_LISTA + SCORE_COAF + SCORE_CAMBIO +
				SCORE_ALERTA6M + SCORE_ESPECIE + SCORE_PEP + SCORE_CNAE);

RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE;BY NuCpfCnpj DESCENDING SCORE_FINAL; RUN;
PROC SORT DATA=BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE NODUPKEY;BY NuCpfCnpj; RUN;
PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE ; TABLES SCORE_FINAL; RUN ;

DATA BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE;
SET BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE;
riscoMatriz = 3;
IF SCORE_FINAL <3 THEN riscoMatriz = 1;
IF SCORE_FINAL >=3 AND SCORE_FINAL <18 THEN riscoMatriz = 2;

RUN;

PROC FREQ DATA=BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE ; TABLES riscoMatriz/nopercent nocum; RUN ;

DATA BS_PJ_COUNT (KEEP=NuCpfCnpj riscoMatriz);
SET BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE;
RUN;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PJ_COUNT NODUPKEY; BY _ALL_; RUN;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_PJ_COUNT AS
	SELECT DISTINCT
    NuCpfCnpj,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_PJ_COUNT
GROUP BY NuCpfCnpj
HAVING Count(*) > 1
;
QUIT;

PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PJ_FIM AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.*,
		  T2.LISTA_ADM_GESTOR AS LISTA_ADM_GESTOR,
          t2.SCORE_COAF AS SCORE_COAF_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_CAMBIO AS SCORE_CAMBIO_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_ALERTA6M AS SCORE_ALERTA6M_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_LISTA AS SCORE_LISTA_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_PEP AS SCORE_PEP_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_ESPECIE AS SCORE_ESPECIE_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_CNAE AS SCORE_CNAE_FIM,
          t2.SCORE_FINAL,
          (CASE WHEN T2.LISTA_ADM_GESTOR = 1 THEN 3 ELSE T2.riscoMatriz END) AS riscoMatriz

     FROM BS_ESPECIE_PJ t1
     LEFT JOIN BS_PJ_FINAL_SCORE T2 ON (T1.NuCpfCnpj = T2.NuCpfCnpj)

     ;
QUIT;

PROC SORT DATA=BS_PJ_FIM NODUPKEY;BY _ALL_;RUN;



PROC SQL;
   CREATE TABLE BS_PJ_FIM_COUNT AS
   SELECT DISTINCT
          t1.ESTEIRA,
          t1.riscoMatriz,
          t1.NuCpfCnpj,
		  T1.NUCONSULTADO,
		  T1.FL_QSA
      FROM BS_PJ_FIM t1
		;

QUIT;

PROC SQL;
	CREATE TABLE BS_PJ_FIM_COUNT AS
	SELECT DISTINCT
    NuCpfCnpj,
	NUCONSULTADO,
	FL_QSA,
    Count(*) AS QTD_DUPLICADO

FROM BS_PJ_FIM_COUNT
